skill.name: debugger

content.value_statement: Bugs waste engineering time when symptoms hide the real cause. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured investigation, hypothesis testing, fixes, and prevention.
actual_capabilities: Structures bug reports into problem, environment, error analysis, hypotheses, investigation, root cause, fix, and prevention sections.
Guides collection of stack traces, logs, environment details, input data, and system state.
Suggests binary search, strategic logging, breakpoints, component isolation, and minimal reproduction cases.
Identifies common bug patterns, including off-by-one errors, null references, race conditions, type mismatches, and stale state.
Produces prioritized hypotheses and concrete verification steps before recommending fixes.
limitations: It needs accurate logs, errors, reproduction steps, or code context to identify a root cause.
It does not execute diagnostics or apply fixes unless the host agent has suitable tool access.
It cannot replace production monitoring, incident response ownership, or security review.
It may ask for environment details before proposing a confident fix.

use_cases.title: Investigate Application Errors
use_cases.description: Turn stack traces, logs, and symptoms into prioritized causes and practical verification steps.

use_cases.title: Triage Production Incidents
use_cases.description: Organize intermittent failures by environment, timing, resource state, and likely contention points.

use_cases.title: Review Regressions Before Release
use_cases.description: Narrow a new failure to recent changes, missing tests, or dependency behavior before shipping.

prompt_templates.title: Explain This Error
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage for a visible error message.
prompt_templates.prompt: Debug this error. I will provide the message, stack trace, expected behavior, actual behavior, and recent changes. Ask only for missing details.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Root Cause
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate analysis when symptoms and logs are available.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these logs and symptoms. Give prioritized hypotheses, evidence for each one, and the next checks needed to confirm the root cause.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reproduction Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused isolation for intermittent or unclear behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimal reproduction plan for this bug. Include required inputs, environment details, isolation steps, and observations that would confirm each hypothesis.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Production Incident
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced incident investigation with risk and verification needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help triage this production incident. Separate symptoms from causes, rank risks, propose safe diagnostics, define rollback signals, and recommend prevention steps.

output_examples.input: A web API returns intermittent internal server errors during traffic spikes.
output_examples.output: The response lists likely causes such as connection pool exhaustion, missing awaits, and unhandled promise rejections. It gives log checks and verification steps.

output_examples.input: A feature worked yesterday but fails after several recent commits.
output_examples.output: The response proposes a regression search, a minimal test case, and evidence needed to isolate the change that introduced the bug.

output_examples.input: A user interface shows stale data after saving changes.
output_examples.output: The response separates cache, state, and API timing hypotheses. It recommends targeted logging and tests to verify the final fix.

best_practices: Provide exact error text, stack traces, recent changes, and expected behavior before asking for a fix.
Validate each hypothesis with one small observation before changing code.
Add a regression test after the root cause is confirmed.
anti_patterns: Do not request broad rewrites before the failure mode is understood.
Do not hide logs, environment details, or reproduction steps that affect the analysis.
Do not treat symptoms as the root cause without supporting evidence.

faq.question: What problems does this skill help debug?
faq.answer: It helps with errors, crashes, regressions, intermittent failures, performance symptoms, and confusing application behavior.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides investigation guidance. Any command execution depends on the host agent and user approval model.

faq.question: Can it analyze stack traces?
faq.answer: Yes. It can explain stack traces, connect them to likely causes, and suggest targeted verification steps.

faq.question: Can it fix the code directly?
faq.answer: It can recommend fixes. Direct edits require a compatible agent with file access, such as Codex or Claude Code.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide expected behavior, actual behavior, reproduction steps, logs, stack traces, environment details, and recent changes.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production incidents?
faq.answer: Yes, for structured triage and diagnostics. Keep human incident owners responsible for customer impact and deployment decisions.
